name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *all* PRs for two weeks first. This gives us real-world data on how it behaves across different PR types without risking bad outcomes. The trade-off is slower feedback for contributors, but we avoid breaking builds or annoying teams with premature automation. After two weeks, we’ll have hard evidence to decide if it’s worth expanding to all PRs or limiting it to new contributors.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode misses PR-Agent’s worst flaw: false negatives. It won’t flag real risks, so teams learn to ignore *all* comments—including the ones that matter. Instead, run a controlled A/B test: PR-Agent on 50% of PRs, manual review on the other 50%, then compare error rates and contributor feedback. That settles it with data, not assumptions.
